name: d365-email-studio
description: Edit and translate existing Dynamics 365 email HTML with local structural validation. Cloudflare serves guidance and validator source only.

interface.longDescription: Make constrained content edits and translations to existing Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Journeys email HTML. Preserve protected markup, tracking, compliance links and Outlook fallbacks. Edit and validate locally; Cloudflare provides only the guide and validator source. Requires a local executor with Python 3 for structural validation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me edit or translate an existing Dynamics 365 email while preserving its protected HTML.
